description: Core and plugin permissions the main window needs. The app's own commands, registered in src-tauri/src/ipc.rs, are not listed here: Tauri gates them through the ACL only once the app ships its own permissions manifest, which it does not. Add a permission here when a core or third-party plugin is introduced, and grant only the commands the frontend calls: of the dialog plugin, only the folder picker behind "Open repository" (dialog:allow-open).
